# Mohammad Shahabuddin — shihabarch.tech
> AI & Systems Consultant — I help businesses adopt AI and improve their data, workflow and infrastructure

Bahrain-based technical solutions specialist. Self-hosted infrastructure, AI adoption,
data platforms and workflow automation for NGOs and SMEs. Named reference:
Discover Islam Society. Business/services entity: Abqariyyah.

## Machine-readable data

## Case Studies
- [Self-Hosted Omnichannel Stack for Multi-Country Outreach](https://shihabarch.tech/case-studies/c1-omnichannel-stack.md): Replaced third-party SaaS with a fully self-hosted omnichannel communication + CRM + analytics + automation ecosystem serving local agents, offshore agents, and management across 20+ countries.
- [The Data-Platform Decision: Evaluating 4 Candidates, Forking Twenty, Adding Row-Level Security](https://shihabarch.tech/case-studies/c2-data-platform-rls.md): Formal requirements-driven evaluation of NocoDB / Twenty / Teable / Mathesar for a master-individual data platform with row+field-level permissions; ended in a surgical Twenty fork adding a community row-level-security engine, white-labelling and a telemetry gate — deployed as the 'Path to Peace' CRM.
- [NMC-first: WhatsApp → Postgres Ingest Pipeline with Tailscale-Only Exposure](https://shihabarch.tech/case-studies/c3-nmc-pipeline.md): Production realtime pipeline: WhatsApp group messages ingested via a legitimate linked device into Postgres, reachable only over a Tailscale network, with passive-ingest guardrails, versioned deployments and two-way Google Sheets sync for non-technical staff.
- [Cost & Sovereignty Audit: 8,000 BHD Saved, $3k/yr SaaS Eliminated, Zero Extended Downtime in a Platform Crisis](https://shihabarch.tech/case-studies/c4-cost-sovereignty.md): Transition from proprietary systems and SaaS subscriptions to a self-hosted open-source stack, plus a big-tech diversification strategy that kept operations running when Facebook blocked management credentials.
- [Marketing Data Operations: From Campaign Chaos to Country-Level Dashboards](https://shihabarch.tech/case-studies/c5-marketing-data-ops.md): Ran the data side of a 20+ country paid-social operation: campaign data prep, phone/country-code normalization at scale, conversion analysis per campaign, and the migration of reporting off Google Sheets into structured databases and dashboards.
- [Realtime Language AI: Translation & Transcription Pipelines Built on a Decade of Multilingual Fieldwork](https://shihabarch.tech/case-studies/c6-realtime-language-ai.md): AI translation/transcription tooling (realtime Arabic↔English, long-audio WhisperX pipelines sized to consumer hardware, TTS/ASR experiments, book-translation repair workflows) built by someone who spent 4 years doing this work by hand at a government protection center.
